items.example: With phone cameras at our fingertips, we are all photographers.

items.translation: на первом плане; в центре внимания
items.example: They put a stranger front and centre of the photo.
You can ask permission after the fact and show the photo.
Taking photos of strangers' children is frowned upon.
Never photograph people in distress — it is an unwritten rule.
A selfie at an accident scene crosses an ethical line.

items.idiom: a picture is worth a thousand words
items.example: The report used one strong photo — a picture is worth a thousand words.
Posting selfies keeps your life in the public eye.

items.idiom: beauty is in the eye of the beholder
items.translation: о вкусах не спорят; красота в глазах смотрящего
items.example: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, so every portrait finds a fan.
The wedding guest stole the spotlight with her selfie.
For a profile photo, everyone puts their best face forward.
Step onto the stage and suddenly all eyes are on you.
The photographer shouted 'say cheese!' before the flash.
Influencers live their lives in the spotlight.
